text: Non-transferability of reputation is essential because, in Akerlof's lemons terms, a transferable reputation market would let capital-rich but competence-poor actors purchase reputation and thereby destroy the signal's informational content.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278

isBasedOn.name: AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment

abstract: In the language of Akerlof's lemons analysis, non-transferability prevents the emergence of a market in which capital-rich but competence-poor actors purchase reputation, undermining the signal's informational content.
